gradients.name: foil
gradients.purpose: The brand's gold foil: elephant mark, header rule, kicker rules, Books byline rule, topic-note dash, nav and menu underlines.

gradients.name: foil-mark
gradients.purpose: Deeper foil for the small elephant marks (header, fleuron, menu foot) on light paper; equals --foil in dark mode.

display.purpose: The one large heading on a page (About, Editing, Books intros).

headline.purpose: Section headings ('Write to us', the Editing call to action) and book titles on Books.

numeral.purpose: Italic gilt roman numerals above About notes and Editing services.

year-numeral.purpose: Gilt Playfair lining numerals for every year on First Lines; 1rem as the plate number, otherwise the size of the surrounding text.

epigraph.purpose: Italic Playfair client testimonial on Editing.

menu-entry.purpose: Phone-menu links, set like a contents page.

first-line-short.purpose: Openings under 90 characters; raised two-line drop cap.

lede.purpose: Opening paragraph under a display heading; a book's hook.

book-title.purpose: Italic <cite> title in the First Lines book block.

blurb.purpose: Back-cover copy on Books, about 36rem measure.

colophon.purpose: The credits row: painting, portrait and text, in the reading face with small-capital labels.

wordmark.purpose: Three-line live-text lock-up beside the elephant.

shadows.name: laid-print
shadows.purpose: Paintings and book covers only; a print laid on the page.

shadows.name: menu-scrim
shadows.purpose: Backdrop dimming the page behind the open phone menu. Not a shadow on the drawer.

florals.component: src/components/Floral.astro (CSS mask over the global .floral rule); src/components/FloralRule.astro for sprigs laid on a rule
florals.source: assets/FLORALS & ELEMENTS, generated into public/brand/florals/ by scripts/brand-assets.ts

placements.where: beside the contact form, under the contact details
Floral Rule on the services top rule
Floral Rule on each entry's top rule
Floral Rule on the footer rule

exclusions: About notes rule: no Floral Rule, it sits under the nested elephant mark.
Never behind text; white watermarks were tried and rejected.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Crossfade between First Lines entries and painting fade-in; 0ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: ui
motion.purpose: Colour and border transitions on buttons, links, inputs.

motion.name: underline
motion.purpose: Nav foil underline growing from the left.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: One-time entrance of the nested mark on About (rotate -6deg, scale 0.96 to rest).

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Phone menu slides in from the right while the scrim fades in.

motion.name: menu-stagger
motion.value: opacity 420ms ease, transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), delay 80ms + 60ms per entry
motion.purpose: Menu entries settle in one after another.

motion.name: menu-underline
motion.purpose: Foil underline growing under a menu entry.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled pill for the action that keeps the visitor here (Another book). Page calls to action use the same fill at 46px, padding 0.65rem 1.5rem.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem; font: 500 0.95rem/1 var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--paper, #f5f0e6); background: var(--ink, #1c1a17); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c1a17); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); border-color: var(--gold, #a07c2c); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #a07c2c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ink-outlined pill for actions that leave the site (Read the book).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem; font: 500 0.95rem/1 var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c1a17); border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--gold, #a07c2c); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #a07c2c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Hairline-outlined pill: the phone Menu and Close buttons, and a book's further links.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 0.95rem; font: 500 0.92rem/1 var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8cfbf); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet svg { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { border-color: var(--gold, #a07c2c); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #a07c2c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled field on the form panel, with gilt focus and rust error.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; } .ds-label { font: 500 0.85rem var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem; font: 1.02rem/1.4 var(--serif, Georgia, serif); color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); background: var(--paper, #f5f0e6); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8cfbf); border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--gold, #a07c2c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold, #a07c2c) 25%, transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #b0452f; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sans nav links with a gold-foil underline that grows on hover and marks the current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2rem; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 0.5rem 0; font: 500 0.92rem var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink-soft, #57514a); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0.2rem; height: 1px; background: var(--foil, linear-gradient(135deg, #a9792b, #f0d999, #9c6f26)); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 220ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #a07c2c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Contents Menu
components.description: Phone drawer links set like a contents page: gilt italic numerals, Playfair entries, hairline rows, a foil underline on the current page.
components.html:
• i.First lines
  • ii.Books
components.css: .ds-toc ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; max-width: 22rem; } .ds-toc li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8cfbf); } .ds-toc a { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.9rem; padding: 0.85rem 0 0.95rem; font: 450 clamp(1.9rem, 9vw, 2.4rem)/1.05 var(--display, Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink-soft, #57514a); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-toc-n { min-width: 2.2rem; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.55em; color: var(--gold, #a07c2c); } .ds-toc-label { background: var(--foil, linear-gradient(135deg, #a9792b, #f0d999, #9c6f26)) left bottom / 0 1px no-repeat; padding-bottom: 0.1em; transition: background-size 260ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-toc a:hover, .ds-toc a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); } .ds-toc a:hover .ds-toc-label, .ds-toc a[aria-current='page'] .ds-toc-label { background-size: 100% 1px; } .ds-toc a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #a07c2c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Kicker
components.description: Short foil rule plus gilt sans label introducing a section (About, Editing).
components.css: .ds-kicker { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0; font: 500 0.8rem var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--gold, #a07c2c); } .ds-kicker::before { content: ''; width: 2.5rem; height: 1px; background: var(--foil, #a07c2c); }

components.name: Chapter Opening
components.description: Signature: an opening sentence with a sunk gilt Playfair drop cap and small-capital lead.
components.html: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
components.css: .ds-opening { margin: 0; font: 380 clamp(1.55rem, 2.7vw, 2.4rem)/1.22 var(--serif, Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); text-wrap: pretty; hanging-punctuation: first; } .ds-opening::first-letter { font-family: var(--display, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 500; color: var(--gold, #a07c2c); initial-letter: 3; margin-right: 0.06em; } @supports not (initial-letter: 2) { .ds-opening::first-letter { float: left; font-size: 2.6em; line-height: 0.82; padding: 0.06em 0.08em 0 0; } } .ds-lead { font-variant-caps: small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.045em; }

components.name: Fleuron Rule
components.description: The elephant mark in mark foil between two hairlines, under the first line. The mask image path is site-relative, so it renders only on the site itself.
components.css: .ds-orn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.9rem; } .ds-orn::before, .ds-orn::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--rule, #d8cfbf); } .ds-orn-mark { width: 1.05rem; height: 1.25rem; background: var(--foil-mark, #a07c2c); -webkit-mask: url('/brand/elephant-mask.png') center / contain no-repeat; mask: url('/brand/elephant-mask.png') center / contain no-repeat; }

components.name: Form Panel
components.description: The one inset surface: deep paper, hairline border, 6px corner, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); background: var(--paper-deep, #ebe3d4); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8cfbf); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-panel-text { margin: 0; font: 450 1.45rem var(--display, Georgia, serif); color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); }

components.name: Floral Rule
components.description: A press botanical laid on a section hairline, the rule broken around it, in full gilt. The mask image path is site-relative, so it renders only on the site itself.
components.css: .ds-ruled { position: relative; height: 3rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8cfbf); } .ds-floral-rule { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; display: flex; padding: 0 0.9rem; background: var(--paper, #f5f0e6); translate: -50% -50%; } .ds-floral { display: block; width: 7.5rem; aspect-ratio: 700 / 246; background: var(--gold, #a07c2c); opacity: 0.85; -webkit-mask: url('/brand/florals/sprig-rule.png') center / contain no-repeat; mask: url('/brand/florals/sprig-rule.png') center / contain no-repeat; }

components.name: Year Numerals
components.description: The book's year in the byline and the painting's plate number, set alike in gilt Playfair lining numerals.
components.css: .ds-byline { margin: 0; font: 0.92rem var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink-soft, #57514a); } .ds-year { font-family: var(--display, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--gold-text, #7d5a1c); } .ds-plate-no { margin: 0.7rem 0 0; text-align: right; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview:
Every screen is set like the first page of a printed chapter. A warm paper ground, near-black ink, and a little gilt where a bookbinder would put it: on the mark, the initial, the rule under the heading. The home page is the purest expression. The opening line of a novel is typeset as a chapter opening, with a sunk gold drop cap, the first words in small capitals, and the press's elephant set as a fleuron on a hairline beneath. A period painting hangs beside it like a frontispiece.

The system is quiet and generous. Density is low, margins are wide, and nothing competes with the text or the painting. Character comes from typesetting detail (optical sizing, small caps, hanging punctuation, lining numerals, italic titles in <cite>) rather than colour or decoration. The press's botanical line drawings appear as a printer would use ornaments: a sprig laid on a section rule, a stem in an empty margin, always in clear paper. Motion is limited to slow crossfades and small settling gestures, and turns off under prefers-reduced-motion.

The site follows the reader's colour scheme. Light is laid paper and ink; dark is the same page by lamplight, with warm near-black paper and a brighter gilt. Both are first-class.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and ink, with gold used sparingly as gilding.
Three type voices with strict jobs: Playfair (display, marks and numerals), Newsreader (reading), Instrument Sans (small UI).
Book typography as interface: drop caps, small capitals, fleurons, hairline rules, roman-numeral sequences, gilt year numerals.
Flat page; the painting and the book cover are the only things that lift.
Two ornament families only: the elephant mark, and the press's botanical line drawings in gilt.

rules.name: The Gilding Rule
rules.body: Gold is gilt, not paint. It appears on marks, drop caps, kickers, numerals, rules, ornaments, link underlines and focus, and nowhere else. Never on large fills, backgrounds, button fills or body text; a gilt border on hover is the most a control gets. Where gilt must be read as text (year numerals), it is Gilt Text, never the lighter Gilt Leaf.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: The only strong colour on a page comes from the painting, portrait or book cover. While an image loads, its frame is filled with the image's own average colour (--art-color, --cover-bg), never a UI grey.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Playfair speaks for the press (display, headings, wordmark, drop caps, numerals). Newsreader carries everything meant to be read. Instrument Sans is for small UI only (labels, buttons, the author line) and never sets a heading, a paragraph or a credit.

rules.name: The Chapter Opening Rule
rules.body: An opening passage starts with a Playfair drop cap in gilt: sunk three lines (initial-letter: 3), or raised two lines for a one-line opening, with a floated fallback where initial-letter is unsupported. The first few words follow in small capitals (font-variant-caps: small-caps). It opens the first line on First Lines and each book's blurb on Books.

rules.name: The Paired Years Rule
rules.body: The book's year and the painting's year are set alike (Year numeral, Gilt Text) so the eye pairs them across the page: in the byline, in the colophon, and as a small plate number under the painting's bottom-right corner. They stay at the size of the text around them; larger datelines and "Painted / Published" labels were tried and rejected as too prominent.

rules.name: The Laid Print Rule
rules.body: Only artwork lifts off the page. UI elements (buttons, panels, inputs, nav, the drawer) never cast shadows.

rules.name: The Clear Paper Rule
rules.body: Florals sit in clear space, never behind text. They fill a quiet margin or column the layout already leaves empty. White watermarks behind text were tried and rejected.

rules.name: The Phone Sprig Rule
rules.body: On phones only the section-rule sprigs, the footer seedling and the Editing pen show; margin drawings hide below 860px.

dos: Do use Laid Paper as the page ground and Press Ink for text, and provide the Night counterparts for dark mode on every new surface.
Do keep gold to gilding: marks, drop caps, kickers, numerals, rules, ornaments, link underlines and focus (The Gilding Rule).
Do set years in gilt Playfair lining numerals in Gilt Text, at the size of the text around them (The Paired Years Rule).
Do set titles of works in italic <cite>, and credit the painting, portrait and text in the colophon, never in scattered captions.
Do open any featured passage with the Chapter Opening treatment (gilt Playfair drop cap and small-capital lead).
Do use the elephant mark (foil, via the mask) as the press's mark and fleuron, and the press's own botanical drawings (via the Floral component) as its only other ornament.
Do place florals in clear paper: in an empty margin or column, or laid on a hairline with the rule broken around them (The Clear Paper Rule).
Do keep crossfades near 380ms and small UI transitions near 160–220ms, and disable all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px and the 2px Gilt Leaf focus outline visible.
donts: Don't put gold on large fills, button fills, backgrounds or body text.
Don't give UI elements shadows; only paintings and covers lift (The Laid Print Rule).
Don't set headings or paragraphs in Instrument Sans, or UI labels in Playfair (The Three Voices Rule).
Don't crop, round or recolour paintings or covers, or use a grey placeholder where the image's average colour belongs.
Don't introduce new accent hues; Rust Error is the only exception, and only for errors.
Don't redraw or restyle the elephant logo or the nested mark; they are binding brand assets.
Don't put a floral behind text, or use one as a pale watermark (The Clear Paper Rule).
Don't show margin florals on phones; only section-rule sprigs, the footer seedling and the Editing pen (The Phone Sprig Rule).
Don't enlarge the years into datelines or label them "Painted" / "Published" (The Paired Years Rule).
Don't lay a floral rule directly under the nested elephant mark; one ornament per view is enough.
